Sustainable total returns which are
enabled through:
• Sustainable ROE which is
significantly above COE
• Potential upside in share price to
deliver capital gain
• Sustainable (and potentially
improved)
earnings per share
• Attractive dividend policy
• Sound balance sheet to protect
against downside risks
Proven tracking records of management
credibility and sound governance
• Appropriate governance structure
and framework
• Compliance with all laws and
regulation
• Being a responsible taxpayer
• Contribution to development of the
industry
• Alignment of our strategy with the
UN SDGs to create economic, social,
technological and environmental
impacts
• Accessibility of our products and
services to all people, businesses and
communities of all demographics
• Promotion of diversity and inclusion
in our banking practices
